name: refresh-google-rollback
description: refresh-google-only, and the script serves the update it held BEFORE the last one (an older sequence): what a vandal with the write key, or a stale Google replica, would hand out. Op google-refresh: the engine refuses it — the signed document's sequence is not newer — keeps its routes, and does not claim to be connected.
analogue: Plan §3.8, test refresh-google-rollback; the freshness rollback rule (specs/relaypack-v1.md: a document's sequence must exceed the last applied).
